L31·N6415unmasked layer
Mostly a "predictable continuation" detector: it gives moderate positive activation on sub-word/token pieces that continue a multi-part name, transliteration or compound (e.g. "trans"+atlantic, "Spam"+Assassin, "Mak"+aur+au, digits inside a patent number), while it is strongly *suppressed* (large negative) on words that spell out an acronym's expansion or repeat an immediately preceding phrase (APA → "Accredited Product Adviser", AFW "stands for" → "Appreciate Fukushima Workers", repeated "rinse aid dispenser").

L31·N7027unmasked layer
